catalog_games_setting_page.header_intro: Enter the path to a game library root. Each first-level folder becomes a root game, and each nested folder under that game becomes a subfolder entry in master data.
catalog_games_setting_page.add_mode_intro: The default keeps the existing path scan flow, but you can switch to entering one game row manually at any time.
catalog_games_setting_page.root_path_intro: Every first-level folder becomes a root game, and each nested folder inside that game becomes a subfolder game.
catalog_games_setting_page.skip_existing_intro: Skip rows that already exist in saved games so the preview only shows new items to import.
catalog_games_setting_page.parent_root_intro: Subfolder entries are attached to an existing root game that you select here.
catalog_games_setting_page.use_folder_name_intro: Use this folder name as the filename prefix in Fanart File instead of a character name.
catalog_games_setting_page.saved_games_empty: There are no saved game entries yet.
catalog_games_setting_page.what_happens_intro: Short summary of this page workflow.
workflow_steps: Pick a library root that contains separate game folders inside it.
Preview which first-level folders become Game entries and which nested folders become Game/Subfolder entries.
Edit, remove, or mark rows that should use the folder name as the Fanart File filename prefix before saving.
catalog_games_setting_page.delete_game_intro: This will remove the selected game entry from the saved games list immediately.

messages.cleared_preview: Cleared the current game folder preview.
messages.duplicate_title: That title already exists for the selected parent folder.
messages.preview_before_save: Preview the import list before saving games.
messages.saved_summary: Saved {root_count} root game entries and {sub_count} subfolder entries.
messages.skipped_rows: Skipped {count} row(s) that were removed or missing required data.

catalog_character_setting_page.header_intro: Enter a root folder that contains game folders, with character reference images directly inside each game folder. Preview, edit names, or remove rows before saving.
catalog_character_setting_page.add_mode_intro: Use the existing folder scan flow, or switch to manual entry when you want to add one character directly.
catalog_character_setting_page.root_path_intro: The expected structure is Root/Game/Image. Each image filename becomes the character name, and the importer matches each game folder against existing master data first.
catalog_character_setting_page.skip_existing_intro: Skip rows that already exist in saved characters so the preview only shows new character imports.
catalog_character_setting_page.manual_intro: Manual mode creates or updates one character entry under an existing root game.
catalog_character_setting_page.reference_image_intro: Upload an optional reference image to include in the preview and save into the character entry.
catalog_character_setting_page.saved_system_intro: Shows the characters already saved in the system, grouped by game.
catalog_character_setting_page.saved_characters_empty: There are no saved characters yet.
workflow_steps: Preview the import list and confirm that each game folder matches existing master data.
Edit character names or remove rows you do not want before saving.
The importer creates or updates Character entries by using each image filename as the character name and that image as the reference image.
catalog_character_setting_page.delete_character_intro: This will remove the selected character from the saved list immediately.
catalog_character_setting_page.upload_new_image_intro: If you choose a new file, it will replace the current reference image.

messages.cleared_preview: Cleared the current character import preview.
messages.duplicate_name: That character name already exists for the selected game.
messages.preview_before_save: Preview the import list before saving characters.
messages.skipped_rows: Skipped {count} row(s) that could not be matched or had no data.
